name: Slack Lists
description: Slack Lists provides structured collaborative task and project tracking inside Slack with customizable fields, views, and workflows.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Slack app token, then let selected agents inspect one bounded item page, draft one text item locally, or create basic to-do Lists and text items under Safe or Dangerous policy.

credentialRequirements.name: SLACK_LISTS_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Slack Lists app token
credentialRequirements.helpText: A bot or user token from the customer's own Slack app with lists:read and lists:write. Railway stores it encrypted and sends it only to slack.com/api.

capabilities.label: Read bounded List items
capabilities.description: Inspect shaped items from one explicit Slack List.

capabilities.label: Create Lists and text items
capabilities.description: Create a basic to-do List or add one bounded text item.

allowed.label: List items
allowed.description: List one bounded page of shaped items from one explicit Slack List.

allowed.label: Draft text item
allowed.description: Prepare one bounded text item locally without a provider side effect.

approvalRequired.label: Create to-do List
approvalRequired.description: Create one basic standalone Slack List in to-do mode.

approvalRequired.label: Add text item
approvalRequired.description: Add one bounded text value to one explicit column in one explicit List.

blocked.label: Destructive changes
blocked.description: List and item deletion, bulk deletion, archival, and arbitrary updates are not exposed.

blocked.label: Access changes
blocked.description: User and channel access grants, revocations, and ownership changes are not exposed.

blocked.label: Sensitive fields
blocked.description: Email, phone, user, attachment, message, link, channel, and reference fields are removed from responses and unavailable for writes.

blocked.label: Downloads and exports
blocked.description: Download jobs, bulk exports, automatic pagination, and broad List discovery are not exposed.

blocked.label: Raw Slack APIs
blocked.description: Arbitrary Slack methods, custom schemas, caller-selected origins, and raw tokens are not exposed.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded item reads and local drafts run directly; each List or item creation requires matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected List and item creation runs without Relay per-action approval while fixed methods, shaping, bounds, audits, Slack scopes, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts four typed Slack Lists tools and attaches the encrypted customer token server-side.
Railway mounts four typed Slack Lists tools and attaches the encrypted customer token server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: A Slack workspace owner must create the customer's own app, grant lists:read and lists:write, install it to the intended workspace, and enter the resulting bot or user token in Relay.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create and install a least-privilege customer-owned Slack app, connect its token, verify the exact workspace and accessible Lists, test Safe approvals and Dangerous writes, then test token revocation and disconnect.

evidence.supports: Slack documents Lists API use cases, methods, permissions, and collaborative List behavior.
Slack documents lists:read for bot and user tokens and the supported item read methods.
Slack documents lists:write for List and item creation, update, deletion, and access methods; Relay mounts only bounded creation.
Slack documents standalone List creation, lists:write, paid-plan availability, and to-do mode.
Slack documents exact List item reads with lists:read, explicit list IDs, limit, and cursor parameters.
Slack documents item creation in an explicit List with initial fields, column IDs, and rich-text blocks.
